boundaries.blocked_surface: tips, rescue steps, evacuation instructions, route guidance, medical response, emergency triage
graphic details, images, rare body changes, searchable scene clues, disaster voyeurism
death toll without names, database language as complete grief, dashboard-only public rendering
single-cause blame, exoneration, climate argument replacing the human death record
certificate, count, database, or report treated as total truth
migration route details, border-search advice, identification crowdsourcing, public sleuthing

safe_rendering_rule: Orient to witnessed language, source limits, and dignity; never instruct, sensationalize, simplify, or identify.
